name: safety bar good morning
description: A hip hinge with a safety squat bar resting on your shoulders, strengthening the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
